title: Prey's Scent
html:
This article is about the Beastmaster passive feature. For the Swarmkeeper version, see Prey's Scent (Swarmkeeper).

Prey's Scent is a passive feature only found on Beast Master Hunter's  Summon Companion.

Description

You deal an additional 1d6⁠⁠Physical damage to creatures marked by your Ranger's  Hunter's Mark.

How to learn

Classes:

  • Class level 3: Beast Master

Used by creatures:

  • Aranea, Aranea Aculeata, Aranea Major, Corvus, Corvus Celer, Corvus Major, Dire Raven, Lupus, Lupus Major, Lupus Optumus, Sharran Spider, Sharran Wolf, Sharran Wolf (Viconia), Ursa, Ursa Ingens, Ursa Major, Verres, Verres Calamitosus, Verres Major

Brief preview

You deal an additional 1d6 damage to targets marked by your ranger.
